data.one_liner: Flexible bottom sheet that can be resized and scrolled.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom bottom sheet widget that can be resized in response to drag gestures and scrolled even without a list. Includes options for sticky headers and height based on content.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet that is both draggable and scrollable.
You require sticky headers inside your bottom sheet.
You want custom anchor points and flexible sizing for bottom sheets.
avoid_when: Standard platform modal bottom sheets fulfill all your requirements without extra customization.
You do not need drag resizing or custom scrolling behavior.
strengths: Can be resized via drag gestures and scrolled even without a list.
Customizable anchors, minimum, initialization, and maximum heights.
weaknesses: Adds an external dependency (`bottom_inset_observer`) for keyboard and inset handling.
